why: SCREEN_ALL_r433 ranked medio-lateral excursion far above every sagittal channel (femur_l.pos_z range 64.6x its floor, control 1.7 cm vs spastic 16.8 cm). Before reporting that as circumduction, the per-cycle series was inspected. It grows monotonically inside the measurement window -- 0.094 to 0.377 m over six cycles in R396SPg110_s101 -- so it is the model losing lateral balance, not a steady gait feature.
THE_GAP_THIS_EXPOSES: Gate G requires t_end >= 9.73 s and >= 5 cycles. It does NOT require the gait to be STATIONARY inside the window. The r417 duration control compares cells by t_end and cannot see a divergence that happens identically WITHIN every cell. This corpus had no test for within-window drift until now.

soleus_l.activation.label: 比目魚肌活化(終末擺盪)

READING.knee_at_heel_strike: STATIONARY. Spastic drift +0.296 deg/cycle against control -0.303 -- the same magnitude, opposite sign. The raw series oscillates about -13.5 deg rather than trending. First-half minus second-half is +1.67 deg in the spastic arm and -1.15 deg in control. THE 6.3919 DEG HEADLINE IS NOT A MEAN OVER A DIVERGENCE.
READING.lateral_excursion: DIVERGENT. Spastic drift +0.051 m/cycle against control +0.0005 -- a hundredfold difference, monotone in every spastic cell, 6/6 in every rung. The 16.8 cm arm mean is an average over a fall in progress and IS NOT A GAIT MEASURE. It must not be reported as circumduction or as compensation.

consequence_for_the_screen: the 711 channels that SCREEN_ALL_r433 found above 5x their floor and dose-monotone have NOT been checked for stationarity. The top of that ranking is dominated by z-axis range channels, which are all facets of the same divergence. No hit from that screen may be pursued until it passes this check.
NEW_STANDING_RULE: any endpoint reported as a mean over the window must also report its per-cycle drift against the control arm's drift on the same channel. A drift ratio above roughly 10x means the quantity is not stationary and the mean is not a gait measure.
UNREGISTERED_OR_SUPERSEDED_LABEL_r438: EXPLORATORY. No registration. A diagnostic that invalidated an exploratory screen result; it does not test a registered hypothesis.
